mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for creating geo-specific topic clusters?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with in-depth keyword research to identify core local topics and supporting sub-topics relevant to your target cities like New York City or Chicago. Next, we audit your existing content to identify gaps or opportunities for optimization. Then, new pillar content and cluster pages are created or updated, with a focus on internal linking to establish relationships between content pieces. Finally, the strategy involves continuous monitoring and refinement based on performance data.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves local keyword research, content auditing, creating/optimizing pillar and cluster content with internal linking, and ongoing performance monitoring.
